verdict.rationale: Claude Design documents direct layout controls to drag, resize, and align elements, which covers only the alignment part of the story. There is no evidence of a pen tool, path or node editing, or boolean operations. Community use shows vector geometry being produced by prompting, with the model guessing badly at unconnected nodes, rather than by hand-editing tools. Missing for 10: pen tool, path/node editing, boolean operations, evidence that alignment is precise (snapping, numeric values), independent hands-on corroboration of vector editing.

support.subject: As a designer, I get professional vector tools — pen and path editing, boolean operations, precise alignment — for real interface design work

citations.quote: Use rich layout controls for quick visual and aesthetic shifts, including to drag, resize, and align elements directly.
you refine through conversation, inline comments, direct edits, or custom sliders (made by Claude) until it's right
